# 21 — Verified review of nameless callables

- [1. Module initialiser thunks](#1-module-initialiser-thunks)
- [2. Closures (callbacks, JSX props, object members, IIFEs)](#2-closures-callbacks-jsx-props-object-members-iifes)

<!-- /toc -->

Generated by `scripts/deep_review.mjs`. This is the per-callable review pass over the closures and
module thunks that have no name of their own in the extracted bundle — the two groups that the
corroboration ladder could previously only cover by inheritance.

For each callable this pass determines its **actual syntactic slot** (callback argument of a named
callee, JSX prop, object property, IIFE, `__esm` module thunk, …) and describes its **own body**
(parameters, return expressions, control flow, direct calls, member writes, initialiser dependencies).
It then re-reads the span it came from and checks every claim: the span bounds, the presence of the
slot evidence where the callable actually sits, the presence of every quoted call, write, return
expression and `init_*` dependency, and a sha1 of the span. An entry is marked verified only when every
one of those checks passes against the source it was read from.

Quoted expressions are rendered verbatim. When the quoted source itself contains a backtick (a template
literal such as ``lines.join(` `)``), the code span uses a longer fence instead of rewriting the text, and the
document contains the source characters unchanged. The audit parses those spans back out of the rendered
sentence and requires each one to occur in the raw span text, so a rewritten or invented claim cannot pass.

Entries: **4248** (4057 closures, 191 module thunks) · verified: **4248** · failures: **0**
